bai em (ol) i ken laikim yu tru,
na bai laip bilong em (ol)
i ken kamap olsem wanpela presen em (ol) i ofarim long yu.

em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol pre na ofa bilong mipela,
mipela i bringim i kam long yu,
bilong selebretim dispela namba wan relijis profesen.

i kam antap long (ol) dispela wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu,
na mekim bai ol promis bilong em (ol) i ken karim gutpela kaikai.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Bikpela i tok olsem, “Man o meri i bihainim laik God, em i brata, na

Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong em
i ken helpim (ol) dispela wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu

Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Na Krais yet i bin promisim ol olsem
em bai i pulapim ol long ol gutpela samting long heven.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel na ol Santu,
mipela i singim song bilong litimapim nem bilong yu,
na oltaim mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Misa bilong makim ol rida na akolait
items.collect:
God, yu bin skulim ol wokmanmeri bilong Sios bilong yu,
olsem ol i no ken wetim ol manmeri long helpim ol. Nogat.
Yu skulim ol olsem ol yet i mas mekim wok
bilong helpim ol bratasusa bilong ol.
Mipela i pre, bai ol i ken inapim gut wok bilong yu,
wantaim daunpasin na pasin bilong pre oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God Papa, yu holi,
Pikinini bilong yu i bin wasim lek bilong ol disaipel,
na em i bin skulim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu, kisim ol ofa bilong mipela,
na helpim mipela long givim mipela yet olgeta long yu,
olsem wanpela sakrifais i stret long ai bilong yu.
Na mekim bai daunpasin na pasin bilong laikim ol manmeri
i ken pulap tru insait long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Ol wokboi i no slip na i was i stap taim bikman i kam, ol i ken amamas.
Mi tok tru long yupela, bikman yet bai i sotim laplap na pasim let, na
bai em i tokim ol long sindaun long tebol. Na em yet bai i kam givim
kaikai long ol.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin givim kaikai na dring bilong heven
long ol wokmanmeri bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, helpim ol,
bai wok bilong ol i ken givim glori long yu tasol,
na i ken helpim salvesen bilong ol bilipmanmeri.
Na strongim ol, bai ol i ken givim witnes long Gutnius bilong yu,
na long ol Sakramen,
na long pasin bilong laikim wanpela narapela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

entrance.text:
I gat kain kain grasia, na wanpela Spirit tasol. I gat kain kain ministri,
na wanpela Bikpela tasol. I gat kain kain wok, na wanpela God tasol.
Na em yet i save givim strong long olgeta manmeri, na i helpim long
mekim olgeta dispela wok.

groups.title: Misa bilong blesim haus lotu na alta

items.title: Misa bilong blesim haus lotu

entrance.text:
God i stap insait long haus holi bilong em. Em i save mekim ol manmeri
i stap long haus bilong em i kamap wan. Em i save givim strong long ol
pipel bilong em. (Aleluya)

alt.text: Yumi go wantaim amamas long haus bilong Bikpela. (Aleluya)

items.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Salim grasia bilong yu i kam long dispela haus lotu,
na pulapim ol manmeri i singaut long yu
wantaim ol presen bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai Tok bilong yu na ol Sakramen
i ken strongim lewa bilong ol manmeri
insait long dispela haus lotu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, Sios bilong yu i amamas,
na em i bringim ol presen i kam long yu.
Mipela i pre, kisim ol dispela presen,
na helpim olgeta manmeri i bung long dispela haus holi,
bai ol Sakramen bilong yu i ken givim laip bilong oltaim long ol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.prefaceNote: Misteri bilong Tempel bilong God

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Haus bilong mi i mas i stap haus bilong beten.
Long dispela haus, husat i askim God, em i save kisim. Na husat i wok
long painim, em i save lukim. Na husat i paitim dua, dua bai i op long
em.” (Aleluya)

alt.text: Ol pikinini bilong Sios bai i raunim tebol bilong Bikpela olsem ol nupela kru bilong diwai oliv. (Aleluya)

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i kisim pinis dispela holi Sakramen bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong em
i ken mekim olgeta tok i tru bilong yu i gro insait long mipela,
bai mipela i ken adorim yu long dispela holi tempel,
na litimapim nem bilong yu wantaim ol Santu long heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

own.title: Misteri bilong Tempel bilong God
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.

Yu bin mekim dispela graun i kamap
olsem wanpela bikpela tempel bilong yu,
bai mipela i ken litimapim nem bilong yu long olgeta ples.
Na tu, yu laik bai mipela i makim ol gutpela ples,
bai mipela i ken lotu long yu,
na bai mipela i ken kisim ol Sakramen bilong heven.
Mipela yet i bin wokim dispela haus bilong pre
long han bilong mipela.
Na mipela i amamas tru long givim em i go bek long yu.

Dispela haus lotu em i piksa bilong trupela Tempel,
na em i piksa bilong Jerusalem i stap long heven.
Santu Maria Virgo i bin karim Pikinini bilong yu.
Na yu bin mekim Bodi bilong Pikinini bilong yu
i kamap Tempel bilong yu yet.
Na God yet i stap long em.

Yu bin kamapim Sios olsem haus holi bilong yu,
na yu bin sanapim em antap long bilip bilong ol Aposel.
Na Jisas Krais yet em i nambawan ston bilong Sios.

Na yu bin kisim ol bilipmanmeri olsem ol ston i gat laip,
na long strong bilong Holi Spirit, yu save givim laip long ol.
Na yu save pulapim ol long laikim pasin bilong yu.
Olsem na nau na inap oltaim, yu save stap wantaim ol,
na lait bilong Krais bai i lait oltaim antap long ol.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel na ol Santu,
mipela tu i litimapim nem bilong yu, Lord,
na mipela i amamas na i sing (tok):

own.title: Misteri bilong Tempel bilong God, em i Sios yet
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Yu bin larim mipela i wokim dispela haus lotu bilong yu.
Long dispela haus lotu,
oltaim yu save soim marimari long famili bilong yu
i wokabaut yet long rot i go long yu.
Na long dispela haus lotu,
yu save mekim mipela i kamap wan wantaim yu.

Mipela i olsem ol ston i gat laip.
Na yu save wokim haus bilong yu wantaim mipela,
na mekim mipela i kamap Sios bilong yu.
Sios em i Bodi bilong Krais,
na em i stap long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Oltaim yu save mekim Sios long graun i kamap bikpela moa yet,
inap long taim em i kamap long Jerusalem bilong heven,
em i ples bilong bel isi, na ples bilong lukim yu.

Olsem na wantaim olgeta Santu na Ensel,
mipela i litimapim nem bilong yu
insait long holi tempel bilong yu.
Na mipela i tenkim yu na tokaut long biknem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Misa bilong blesim alta
items.offerings:
Lord, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre, salim Holi Spirit bilong yu
i kam antap long dispela alta,
bai em i ken mekim ol dispela presen i kamap holi,
na bai em i ken klinim hat bilong ol manmeri
i laik kisim dispela Sakramen.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

entrance.text:
God, yu helpim bilong mi, yu ken lukluk long mipela. Lukim pes bilong
dispela man yu bin makim bilong yu yet. Wanpela de insait long haus
bilong yu i winim tru wan tausen de long narapela ples. (Aleluya)

alt.text: Bai mi go long alta bilong yu, God. Long wanem, em i save mekim mi i belgut na amamas. (Aleluya)

items.collect:
God, taim Pikinini bilong yu
i hangamap long alta bilong Diwai Kros,
yu bin pulim olgeta samting i kam klostu long em.
Mipela i pre, pulapim Sios bilong yu
wantaim grasia bilong heven.
Sios i laik givim dispela alta i go long yu.
Long dispela alta yu bai i bungim olgeta bilipmanmeri bilong yu,
na yu bai i givim kaikai long ol.
Na yu bai i pulapim ol long Spirit bilong yu,
na mekim ol i kamap pipel holi bilong yu yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.prefaceNote: Krais yet em i alta

communion.text:
Ol liklik pisin i painim wanpela haus, na ol i lukautim ol pikinini
bilong ol. Ol i stap klostu long alta bilong yu, Bikpela, yu King bilong
mi na God bilong mi. Ol manmeri i save stap long haus bilong yu, na i
litimapim nem bilong yu oltaim, ol i ken amamas. (Aleluya)

alt.text: Ol pikinini bilong Sios bai i raunim tebol bilong Bikpela olsem ol nupela kru bilong diwai oliv. (Aleluya)

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mekim mipela i stap oltaim klostu
long dispela alta bilong yu.
Long wanem, long em,
yumi save selebretim Sakramen bilong sakrifais bilong Krais.
Na long em, mipela i save kisim kaikai long han bilong Krais yet.
Mipela i pre, mekim mipela olgeta i kamap wan
long bilip na long laikim pasin,
bai mipela i ken kamap wankain olsem Krais.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio bilong dispela Misa hia

own.title: Krais yet em i alta
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Krais em i Pris tru, na em i ofa tru.
Em i bin ofarim laip bilong em yet antap long Diwai Kros,
olsem sakrifais bilong kisim bek mipela.
Na em i bin tokim mipela long mekim dispela ofa
bilong tingim sakrifais bilong em.

Lord, pipel bilong yu i bin wokim dispela alta,
na nau ol i amamas long givim em i go bek long yu.
Dispela alta em i bikpela samting tru.
Long wanem, long dispela alta,
ol bai i ofarim sakrifais bilong Krais
aninit long mak bilong Sakramen.
Na dispela sakrifais i winim olgeta ofa,
na em i save givim bikpela ona long yu,
na em i save kisim bek mipela.

Long dispela alta,
ol bai i redim kaikai bilong Bikpela Jisas.
Olsem na ol pikinini bilong yu
bai i kisim Bodi bilong Krais,
na ol bai i kamap wan insait long holi Sios bilong yu.

Long dispela alta,
ol bilipmanmeri bai i kisim Spirit bilong yu,
Krais yet i bin givim long ol.
Na long strong bilong dispela Spirit,
ol tu bai i kamap olsem wanpela ofa i holi,
na wanpela alta i gat laip.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel na ol Santu,
mipela tu i litimapim nem bilong yu, Lord,
na mipela i amamas na i sing (tok):

sections.title: OL MISA NA PRE BILONG KAIN KAIN WOK NA ASKIM

groups.title: Ol Misa bilong helpim Holi Sios

items.title: Misa bilong helpim Sios 1

entrance.text:
God i bin mekim yumi i save long misteri bilong laik bilong em. Em i
laik bungim olgeta samting long Krais, ol samting bilong heven na ol
samting bilong graun.

items.collect:
God, long save na gutpela tingting bilong yu,
yu laik bai Kingdom bilong Krais
i kamap long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na yu laik bai wok ridima bilong em
i ken kisim bek olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim yu, bai Sios bilong yu
i ken i stap Sakramen bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri,
na Krais i ken kamap ples klia
olsem hop na Sevia bilong olgeta lain pipel bilong graun.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God bilong marimari,
lukdaun long ol ofa bilong pipel bilong yu.
Long strong bilong dispela Sakramen,
mekim bai olgeta bilipmanmeri i ken i stap pipel bilong yu yet.
Helpim ol long i stap gutpela lain pris, na lain holi,
na lain bilong yu stret.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Spirit wantaim meri bilong Pikinini Sipsip, tupela i tok, “Yu kam.
Amen. Bikpela Jisas, yu kam.”

items.postcommunion:
God, oltaim yu save givim kaikai long Sios bilong yu,
na yu save strongim em long ol Sakramen bilong yu.
Nau tasol mipela i bin kisim kaikai long tebol bilong yu.
Mipela i pre,
helpim mipela long bihainim oltaim ol skul bilong yu,
bai mipela i ken kamap olsem yis namel long ol arapela manmeri,
na bai mipela i ken helpim ol long kisim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

own.title: Bodi bilong Krais em i wanpela tasol. Na Sios em i Bodi bilong Krais
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long wok bilong Krais,
yu bin mekim mipela i save long tok tru bilong yu.
Na yu laik bai wanpela bilip na wanpela Baptais tasol
i ken bungim mipela,
na mekim mipela i kamap Bodi bilong em yet.

Long wok bilong Krais, yu bin salim Holi Spirit bilong yu
i kam long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na Holi Spirit i save givim kain kain presen long ol bilipmanmeri,
bai ol i ken wok bung wantaim,
na bai ol i ken kamap wanpela lain tasol.
Na nau Holi Spirit i stap yet wantaim mipela, ol pikinini bilong yu,
na em i save givim laip na stiaim Sios bilong yu.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Misa bilong helpim Sios 2

entrance.text:
Mi lukim bikpela lain manmeri tru i bung i stap, na i no gat man inap
long kaunim namba bilong ol. Ol dispela lain ol i bilong olgeta kantri,
na bilong olgeta kala skin, na bilong olgeta lain pipel, na bilong olgeta
tok ples.

items.collect:
God, oltaim yu save bungim ol manmeri
bilong olgeta hap bilong graun long kontrak bilong Krais.
Na yu mekim ol pipel i gro wantaim long strong bilong Spirit.
Mipela i pre,
bai Sios bilong yu i ken bihainim gut wok misin bilong em.
Olsem na em i ken kamap olsem yis na sol bilong olgeta pipel,
na givim nupela laip bilong Krais long ol,
na mekim ol i kamap famili bilong God yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, marimari long mipela,
na kisim ol dispela presen mipela i laik ofarim long yu.
Sios bilong yu i bin kamap long sait bilong Krais,
taim em i dai long Diwai Kros.
Mipela i askim yu, bai dispela Sakramen i ken helpim Sios
long bihainim pasin holi,
na i ken helpim em long harim oltaim tok bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

communion.text:
Wanpela soldia i sutim sait bilong em long spia. Na wantu blut wantaim
wara i kapsait.

alt.text: Olgeta blesing, na glori, na gutpela tingting, na grasia, na ona, na pawa, na strong, ol i bilong God bilong yumi tasol, inap oltaim oltaim. Amen.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim strong
long Sakramen bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai yu ken mekim wok bilong Sios bilong yu
i karim planti kaikai.
Long wanem, long wok bilong em
yu save skulim ol tarangu long misteri bilong salvesen,
na yu save singautim ol long kam insait
long Kingdom bilong yu i no inap pinis.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 8 bilong ol Sande bilong Taim bilong Yia, p. 517.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim Sios 3

entrance.text:
Long ples tupela o tripela man i kam bung long nem bilong mi, orait mi
yet mi stap namel long ol.

alt.text: Yumi planti manmeri, tasol yumi stap wanpela bodi tasol long Krais. Na yumi wan wan i stap olsem poroman bilong ol arapela.

items.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta, mipela i askim yu,
bai Sios bilong yu i ken i stap oltaim holi pipel bilong yu.
Mekim em i stap wan wankain olsem Papa,
na Pikinini na Holi Spirit.
Olsem na em bai i kamap mak bilong pasin holi
na pasin wanbel bilong yu long dispela graun,
na em bai i mekim olgeta manmeri i pulap
long laikim pasin bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i selebretim dispela Sakramen
na mipela i tingim bikpela laikim pasin
bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai Sios bilong yu
i ken mekim wok ridima bilong Krais i kamap
long olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Yumi planti, tasol yumi stap olsem wanpela bret na wanpela bodi tasol.
Long wanem, yumi olgeta i save kaikai long wanpela Bret na dring long
wanpela Kap.

items.postcommunion:
God, long dispela gutpela Sakramen
yu save givim strong na bel isi long Sios.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen i ken helpim pipel bilong yu
long pas wantaim Krais,
bai ol wok ol i mekim long dispela taim nau,
i ken helpim ol long sanapim Kingdom bilong yu
i save stap oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio bilong Misa bilong askim God long mekim ol Kristen i kamap

items.title: Misa bilong helpim Sios 4

entrance.text:
Papa, mi beten bilong helpim ol manmeri husat bai i bilip long mi, bai
ol i ken i stap wan, olsem yu Papa, yu stap long mi na mi stap long yu.

items.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Long wok bilong Krais,
yu bin soim glori bilong yu long olgeta lain manmeri.
Marimari long holi Sios bilong yu long olgeta hap bilong graun,
bai em i ken i stap strong long bilip,
na bai oltaim em i ken givim witnes long nem bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.offerings:
God, long strong bilong sakrifais bilong Krais,
yu bin mekim Sios bilong yu i kamap klin,
na oltaim yu save mekim em i kamap holi.
Mipela i pre, bai Sios i ken pas long Krais, em i Het bilong em,
na em i ken ofarim em yet long yu wantaim Krais,
na bihainim laik bilong yu oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Man o meri i pas long mi na mi pas long em, em i
save karim planti kaikai. Long wanem, sapos yupela i lusim mi, yupela
i no inap mekim wanpela samting.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin givim kaikai holi long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai yu ken stiaim Sios bilong yu oltaim,
na helpim em long i stap fri,
na long sanap strong long trupela bilip.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 8 bilong ol Sande bilong Taim bilong Yia, p. 517.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim Sios 5

entrance.text:
Krais i save laikim yumi, na long blut bilong em, em i bin mekim yumi i
kamap klin long sin. Em i bin mekim yumi i kamap king na pris bilong
God, em i Papa bilong em. Olgeta glori na strong em i bilong em tasol,
inap oltaim oltaim. Amen.

items.collect:
God, long olgeta hap bilong graun Sios bilong yu i stap.
Na yu soim olsem Sios bilong yu em i wanpela,
em i holi, em i Katolik, na em i kam long ol Aposel.
Helpim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu
long bihainim gut ol wasman bilong ol,
na mekim ol i bung wantaim long Holi Spirit,
long Gutnius na long Yukaris.
Olsem na bai ol manmeri bilong graun i ken luksave olsem,
ol bilipmanmeri em ol pipel bilong yu stret,
na Krais yet i stap namel long ol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

own.title: Bodi bilong Krais em i wanpela tasol. Na Sios em i Bodi bilong Krais
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long wok bilong Krais,
yu bin mekim mipela i save long tok tru bilong yu.
Na yu laik bai wanpela bilip na wanpela Baptais tasol
i ken bungim mipela,
na mekim mipela i kamap Bodi bilong em yet.

Long wok bilong Krais, yu bin salim Holi Spirit bilong yu
i kam long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na Holi Spirit i save givim kain kain presen long ol bilipmanmeri,
bai ol i ken wok bung wantaim,
na bai ol i ken kamap wanpela lain tasol.
Na nau Holi Spirit i stap yet wantaim mipela, ol pikinini bilong yu,
na em i save givim laip na stiaim Sios bilong yu.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Misa bilong helpim Pop

entrance.text:
Yu Pita, na bai mi wokim Sios bilong mi antap long dispela ston. Na
strong bilong hel bai i no inap daunim em. Bai mi givim ol ki bilong
Kingdom bilong Heven long yu.

items.collect:
God, long stretpela tingting na save bilong yu,
yu bin mekim Sios bilong yu i sanap antap long Santu Pita,
na yu bin makim em bilong i go pas long ol arapela Aposel.
Mipela i pre,
lukdaun wantaim marimari long Pop bilong mipela N..
Yu yet i bin makim em bilong kisim ples bilong Pita.
Helpim em long sanap olsem strongpela ston
bilong holim bilip na pasin wanbel bilong pipel bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela ofa bilong mipela,
na stiaim holi Sios bilong yu wantaim Pop N.,
em i Pop bilong mipela.
Long wanem, yu yet i bin makim em olsem wasman bilong Sios.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
“Saimon, pikinini bilong Jon, ating yu laikim mi moa long ol dispela
man, a?” “Bikpela, yu save long olgeta samting. Yu save, mi laikim yu.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin singautim mipela
long kisim kaikai bilong heven long tebol bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong dispela Sakramen
i ken helpim Sios bilong yu long i stap wan
na long bihainim laikim pasin.
Yu bin makim wokman bilong yu N. olsem wasman bilong Sios.
Lukautim em, na kisim em i go long laip bilong oltaim
wantaim ol lain sipsip yu bin givim long em.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim Bisop

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Bai mi painim ol sipsip bilong mi, na bai mi
makim wanpela wasman bilong lukautim ol. Na mi, Bikpela yet, bai
mi stap God bilong ol.”

items.collect:
God, yu Wasman bilong oltaim
bilong ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu.
Oltaim yu save lukautim Sios bilong yu na stiaim em
wantaim laikim pasin bilong yu.
Na yu bin makim wokman bilong yu N.,
bai em i go pas long pipel bilong yu,
na em i makim Krais olsem wasman bilong ol sipsip.
Helpim em, bai em i ken inapim gut wok bilong yu,
na bai em i ken skulim ol manmeri long trupela bilip,
na mekim gutpela wok Pris bilong onarim yu,
na stiaim gut ol bilipmanmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, dispela ofa bilong mipela
i ken kamap gut long ai bilong yu,
na em i ken helpim wokman bilong yu N..
Yu bin makim em,
bai em i go pas long pipel bilong yu olsem Bikpris.
Pulapim em long ol presen bilong yu
na long pasin bilong ol Aposel,
bai em i ken helpim gut ol lain sipsip bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Pikinini bilong Man i no bin kam bai ol manmeri i mekim wok bilong
helpim em. Nogat. Em i kam bilong helpim ol, na bilong givim laip
bilong em bilong kisim bek planti manmeri.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, long strong bilong dispela Sakramen,
pulapim wokman bilong yu N.
long ol presen bilong grasia bilong yu.
Helpim em long i stap gutpela wasman,
na givim laip bilong oltaim long em,
em i dispela laip yu bin promisim long ol gutpela wasman.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa long taim bilong eleksen bilong nupela Pop o nupela Bisop

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Bai mi makim wanpela gutpela pris, na em bai
i bihainim laik na tingting bilong mi. Bai mi givim pe bilong oltaim
long em, na em bai i wokabaut long ai bilong mi olgeta de bilong laip
bilong em.”

items.collect:
God, yu Wasman bilong oltaim,
na yu save stiaim na lukautim gut ol sipsip bilong yu.
Long bikpela marimari bilong yu,
givim wanpela gutpela wasman long Sios bilong yu.
Na helpim dispela wasman long bihainim pasin holi oltaim,
na long was gut long mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, marimari bilong yu i ken helpim mipela.
Nau mipela i bringim dispela ofa holi i kam long yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai yu ken mekim mipela i amamas
long wanpela wasman i bihainim pasin bilong yu,
na i go pas long holi Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Mi bin makim yupela bilong i stap ol lain bilong
mi. Na mi bin givim wok long yupela, bai yupela i ken i go na karim
kaikai, na bai kaikai bilong yupela i ken i stap gut.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kamap nupela gen
long dispela Sakramen bilong salvesen,
em i Bodi na Blut bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, long grasia bilong yu,
mekim mipela i amamas long wanpela nupela wasman.
Helpim em long skulim pipel bilong yu wantaim ol gutpela pasin,
na long strongim ol bilipmanmeri wantaim ol tok i tru
i kam long Gutnius.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim wanpela kaunsel o sinod

entrance.text:
Pasin bilong laikim wanpela narapela i winim olgeta arapela pasin, na
em i inapim olgeta gutpela pasin wantaim. Yupela i mas larim bel isi
bilong Krais i pulap long hat bilong yupela.

items.collect:
Lord, yu save stiaim na lukautim Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, salim spirit bilong gutpela save,
na bilong tok i tru, na bilong bel isi
i kam antap long ol wokmanmeri bilong yu.
Helpim ol long luksave long ol pasin yu save laikim.
Na strongim ol, bai ol i ken bihainim ol dispela pasin
wantaim olgeta strong bilong ol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God bilong marimari, lukdaun long ol ofa
bilong ol wokmanmeri bilong yu.
Givim grasia na lait bilong yu long ol,
bai ol i ken save long ol pasin i stret long ai bilong yu.
Na strongim ol, bai ol i ken bihainim ol dispela pasin.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Long ples trupela laikim pasin i stap long em, God tu i stap long em.
Laikim pasin bilong Krais i bin bungim yumi wantaim.

items.postcommunion:
God bilong marimari,
mipela i kisim pinis ol holi presen bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, dispela Sakramen i ken strongim
ol wokmanmeri bilong yu long tok i tru,
na i ken helpim ol long onarim oltaim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 2 bilong Holi Spirit, p 1135

own.title: Prefasio 2 bilong Holi Spirit
own.subtitle: Wok bilong Holi Spirit insait long Sios
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Yu save lukautim gut olgeta samting,
na yu save stiaim Sios bilong yu long kain kain rot.
Long strong bilong Holi Spirit,
oltaim yu save helpim Sios,
bai em i ken bihainim laik bilong yu tasol.
Olsem na long taim bilong hevi,
Sios i save singaut long helpim bilong yu.
Na long taim bilong amamas,
em i save tenkim yu,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Misa bilong helpim ol Pris

entrance.text:
Spirit bilong Bikpela i stap long mi. Long wanem, Bikpela i bin welim
mi, na em i salim mi long autim Gutnius long ol tarangu, na long oraitim
ol manmeri i pilim sori long bel bilong ol, na long mekim i kamap fri ol
manmeri i karim bikpela hevi.

items.collect:
God, yu bin makim Pikinini bilong yu wanpela tasol
olsem Hetpris bilong Oltaim.
Mipela i pre, helpim ol man em yet i bin makim
olsem wokman na wasman bilong ol Sakramen bilong yu,
bai ol i ken bihainim em gut,
na inapim gut dispela wok ol i bin kisim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, yu bin makim ol Pris bilong mekim wok bilong yu
long holi alta, na bilong helpim ol pipel bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai strong bilong dispela sakrifais
i ken mekim ol wok bilong ol i kamap stret long ai bilong yu,
na ol dispela wok i ken karim kaikai insait long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Papa, yu holi, mekim ol i kamap holi long tok i
tru. Tok bilong yu i tru olgeta. Bipo yu bin salim mi, na mi kam long
graun. Olsem tasol mi bin salim ol i go i stap namel long ol manmeri
bilong graun.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin ofarim
dispela sakrifais bilong heven long yu,
na mipela i bin kisim em tu.
Mipela i pre, givim nupela laip long ol Pris bilong yu,
na long olgeta wokman bilong yu.
Helpim ol long pas oltaim long laikim pasin bilong yu,
bai grasia bilong yu i ken mekim olgeta wok bilong ol
i kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa Pris i selebretim bilong helpim em yet 1

entrance.text:
God yet i bin makim mi, na mi kamap wokman bilong Sios, bilong
helpim yupela. Mipela i save telimautim nem bilong Krais, bilong
helpim olgeta manmeri long kamap stret long ai bilong Krais Jisas.

items.collect:
God, mi no gutpela man inap long mi mekim dispela wok.
Tasol long grasia bilong yu,
yu bin makim mi bilong i go pas long famili bilong yu.
Olsem na mi askim yu,
helpim mi long inapim gut dispela wok Pris bilong mi.
Na lukautim mi, bai mi ken stiaim gut ol lain pipel
yu bin trastim long wok bilong mi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, long strong na long marimari bilong yu,
yu save stiaim olgeta de na olgeta taim.
Na long grasia bilong yu, yu bin givim dispela wok long mi.
Long strong bilong dispela ofa, marimari long mi,
na stiaim lewa bilong mi na bilong ol pipel,
bai ol sipsip i ken harim tok bilong ol wasman,
na ol wasman i ken lukautim gut ol sipsip.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Papa i laikim mi tumas, na long wankain pasin mi
bin laikim yupela. Oltaim yupela i mas i stap insait long dispela laikim
bilong mi.”

items.postcommunion:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Na yu as na Papa bilong olgeta pasin holi.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen, nau tasol mipela i kisim pinis,
i ken helpim mi long bihainim olgeta pasin i stret,
na long tokaut long olgeta tok i tru,
bai olgeta pasin na toktok bilong mi
i ken skulim ol bilipmanmeri long grasia bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa Pris i selebretim bilong helpim em yet 2

entrance.text:
Mi tokim Bikpela olsem, “Yu Bikpela bilong mi. Yu nambawan
samting tru long laip bilong mi. Bikpela, yu yet i bin skelim ol samting,
na makim ol gutpela hap bilong mi. Na yu save was long ol samting
bilong mi.”

items.collect:
God bilong marimari,
marimari long mi, na harim ol pre bilong mi.
Pulapim hat bilong mi long grasia bilong Holi Spirit,
bai mi ken i stap gutpela man inap long selebretim gut
ol Sakramen bilong yu,
na long mekim gutpela wok bilong helpim Sios bilong yu.
Helpim mi, bai mi ken laikim yu inap oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, yu strong olgeta, kisim ol dispela ofa,
mipela i bringim i kam bilong onarim yu.
Krais em i Pris na sakrifais wantaim,
na em i bin givim wok Pris bilong em yet long mi tu.
Olsem na mi askim yu, helpim mi long givim mi yet olgeta
olsem wanpela gutpela sakrifais i stret long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Jisas i bin tok olsem long ol man i bin i stap wantaim em long taim
bilong traim, “Mi givim Kingdom bilong mi long yupela. Na long
Kingdom bilong mi, yupela bai i sindaun long tebol bilong mi, na
kaikai na dring.”

items.postcommunion:
God Papa, yu holi, yu bin strongim mi long Bret bilong Heven,
na yu bin givim amamas long mi
long Kap bilong Nupela Kontrak.
Nau mi askim yu, helpim mi long mekim gut wok bilong yu,
na long givim laip bilong mi bilong helpim olgeta manmeri
long kisim salvesen i kam long yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa Pris i selebretim bilong helpim em yet 3

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i no bin makim mi bilong i stap wantaim
yupela. Nogat. Mi bin makim yupela bilong i stap ol lain bilong mi. Na
mi bin givim wok long yupela, bai yupela i ken i go na karim kaikai, na
bai kaikai bilong yupela i ken i stap gut.”

items.collect:
God Papa, yu holi, mi no gutpela man inap
long mi mekim dispela wok.
Tasol yu no bin skelim ol pasin bilong mi,
na yu bin makim mi bilong serim wok Pris bilong Krais,
em i Pris bilong Oltaim.
Na yu bin singautim mi bilong mekim wok
bilong helpim Sios bilong yu.
Helpim mi, bai mi ken wok strong bilong autim Gutnius,
na i stap gutpela wokman bilong ol Sakramen bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, dispela sakrifais i save givim ona long yu.
Nau mipela i laik ofarim em,
bilong askim yu long helpim mi long mekim gut wok bilong yu.
Mi no gutpela man tumas,
tasol yu bin makim mi bilong kamap Pris bilong yu.
Nau mipela i pre, bai yu ken helpim mi
long inapim gut dispela wok bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Dispela kap bilong blesing yumi save blesim, em i save bungim yumi
wantaim blut bilong Krais. Na dispela bret yumi save brukim, em i
save bungim yumi wantaim bodi bilong Krais.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mi amamas
long tingim aniveseri bilong ordinesen bilong mi,
na mi bin selebretim dispela Sakramen
bilong givim glori long nem bilong yu.
Helpim mi, bai mi ken kamap olsem Krais yet,
nau tasol mi bin holim em long han bilong mi
long sakrifais bilong Misa.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim ol wokmanmeri bilong Sios

communion.text:
I gat kain kain grasia, na wanpela Spirit tasol. I gat kain kain ministri,
na wanpela Bikpela tasol. I gat kain kain wok, na wanpela God tasol.
Na em yet i save givim strong long olgeta manmeri, na i helpim long
mekim olgeta dispela wok.

items.collect:
God, yu bin skulim ol wokmanmeri bilong Sios bilong yu,
olsem ol i no ken wetim ol manmeri long helpim ol. Nogat.
Yu skulim ol olsem ol yet i mas mekim wok
bilong helpim ol bratasusa bilong ol.
Mipela i pre, bai ol i ken inapim gut wok bilong yu,
wantaim daunpasin na pasin bilong pre oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God Papa, yu holi,
Pikinini bilong yu i bin wasim lek bilong ol disaipel,
na em i bin skulim mipela long bihainim pasin bilong em.
Mipela i askim yu, kisim ol ofa bilong mipela,
na helpim mipela long givim mipela yet olgeta long yu,
olsem wanpela sakrifais i stret long ai bilong yu.
Na mekim bai daunpasin na pasin bilong laikim ol manmeri
i ken pulap tru insait long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin givim kaikai na dring bilong heven
long ol wokmanmeri bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, helpim ol,
bai wok bilong ol i ken givim glori long yu tasol,
na i ken helpim salvesen bilong ol bilipmanmeri.
Na strongim ol, bai ol i ken givim witnes long Gutnius bilong yu,
na long ol Sakramen,
na long pasin bilong laikim wanpela narapela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong askim God long ol vokesen bilong Sakramen bilong Holi Ordo

entrance.text:
Jisas i tokim ol disaipel bilong em olsem, “Yupela i mas beten long
Papa bilong gaden, bai em i salim ol wokman i go wok long gaden
bilong em.”

items.collect:
God, long gutpela tingting na save bilong yu,
yu save givim ol wasman long pipel bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, salim spirit bilong strongpela bilip
na gutpela pasin long Sios bilong yu.
Na singautim planti gutpela wokman
bilong mekim wok long alta bilong yu,
na helpim ol long kamap gutpela witnes
bilong Gutnius bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, harim ol pre bilong pipel bilong yu,
na kisim ol ofa bilong ol.
Mipela i askim yu, singautim planti man long kamap wokman
bilong ol Sakramen bilong yu.
Na helpim ol long wokabaut oltaim long laikim pasin bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Krais i bin lusim laip bilong em yet bilong helpim yumi, na long
dispela pasin yumi ken save long laikim pasin bilong God i kam long
yumi. Olsem na yumi tu i mas lusim laip bilong yumi bilong helpim ol
bratasusa.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i kisim pinis Bret bilong Heven
long tebol bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Sakramen bilong laikim pasin bilong yu
i ken karim planti kaikai insait long gaden bilong Sios.
Olsem na planti man moa i ken bihainim singaut bilong yu,
na mekim wok bilong yu, na helpim ol bratasusa bilong ol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim ol le manmeri

entrance.text:
Kingdom bilong Heven em i olsem yis. Wanpela meri i kisim wanpela
hap yis na i tanim wantaim tripela hap plaua. Na bihain dispela plaua
olgeta i solap.

items.collect:
God, Gutnius bilong yu i save mekim olgeta manmeri
i kamap gutpela pikinini bilong yu,
wankain olsem yis i save mekim plaua i kamap gutpela bret.
Na yu bin singautim planti bilipmanmeri
long i stap namel long ol arapela manmeri,
na ol i save mekim kain kain wok.
Mipela i pre, bai spirit bilong Kristen pasin i ken pulap long ol.
Olsem na taim ol i mekim ol wok bilong ol,
ol i ken mekim Kingdom bilong yu i kamap bikpela moa yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, long sakrifais bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
yu bin kisim bek olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Long strong bilong ofa bilong em, strongim ol le manmeri,
na helpim ol long mekim planti wok aposel,
bai ol i ken mekim spirit bilong Krais i pulap long graun,
na soim pasin holi long olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Yupela olgeta manmeri bilong graun, yupela i mas singsing amamas
long Bikpela. Yupela i mas mekim wok bilong Bikpela wantaim
amamas. Yupela i go klostu long em, na singim song bilong amamas.

alt.text: Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i mas karim planti kaikai na i stap disaipel bilong mi, na long dispela pasin Papa bilong mi i kisim glori.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu pulap long grasia,
na nau tasol mipela i bin kisim grasia bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong dispela Yukaris
i ken helpim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu
i stap namel long ol wok bilong graun.
Helpim ol long kamap gutpela witnes
bilong tok i tru bilong Gutnius bilong yu,
na mekim Sios bilong yu i kamap strong
namel long olgeta ektiviti bilong dispela taim nau.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong tingim aniveseri bilong marit 1
items.collect:
God, yu bin kamapim olgeta samting.
Bipo tru yu bin wokim man na meri,
na yu bin putim strongpela laikim pasin insait long tupela,
bai tupela i ken pas long kontrak bilong Marit.
Mipela i askim yu, blesim na strongim Marit bilong N. na N.,
bai Marit bilong tupela i ken kamap olsem gutpela piksa
bilong Krais i pas long Sios bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, yu bin mekim blut na wara
i kapsait long sait bilong Krais,
olsem mak bilong ol Sakramen i save mekim mipela
i kamap nupela gen.
Nau mipela i bringim dispela ofa i kam long yu,
bilong tenkim yu long tupela wokmanmeri bilong yu, N. na N..
Mipela i pre, kisim dispela ofa bilong mipela,
na pulapim Marit bilong tupela long ol presen bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin givim kaikai na dring bilong heven
long tupela pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, pulapim tupela long amamas bilong yu,
na mekim bai haus bilong tupela i ken kamap ples
bilong stretpela pasin na bel isi,
na tupela i ken laikim olgeta manmeri i kam long haus bilong ol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong tingim aniveseri bilong marit 2
items.collect:
Lord, yu bin pasim tupela wokmanmeri bilong yu N. na N.
long Sakramen bilong Marit,
na dispela Sakramen i no inap bruk.
Na yu bin i stap wantaim tupela
long taim nogut na long gutpela taim.
Mipela i askim yu, strongim laikim pasin bilong tupela,
bai tupela i ken amamas (wantaim ol pikinini bilong tupela)
long helpim wanpela narapela
long wokabaut long rot bilong ol pasin holi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, mipela i bringim dispela ofa i kam long yu,
bilong tenkim yu long tupela wokmanmeri bilong yu,
N. na N.. Mipela i askim yu, bai dispela Sakramen
i ken pulapim tupela long gutpela taim na amamas bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
God, yu bin singautim N. na N.
(wantaim ol pikinini na ol pren bilong tupela)
long dispela kaikai bilong heven,
yu yet i bin redim bilong famili bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, strongim laikim pasin bilong tupela,
na helpim tupela long wokabaut wantaim,
inap long taim tupela i ken kamap
long bikpela kaikai bilong heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong tingim aniveseri bilong marit 3
items.collect:
God, yu Papa na yu strong olgeta,
lukdaun wantaim marimari long N. na N.
(wantaim ol pikinini bilong tupela.
Tupela i bin givim laip na bilip long ol).
Tupela i bin i stap wantaim 50-pela yia,
na tupela i bin mekim planti gutpela pasin wantaim.
Long bigin bilong wokabaut bilong tupela,
yu bin pasim tupela long Sakramen bilong Marit.
Mipela i askim yu, blesim tupela nau,
na givim gutpela taim bilong yu long tupela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, mipela i bringim dispela ofa i kam long yu,
bilong tenkim yu
long tupela wokmanmeri bilong yu, N. na N..
Tupela i bin i stap wantaim planti yia,
na tupela i bin laikim na rispektim wanpela narapela.
Mipela i pre, helpim tupela,
na blesim tupela wantaim pasin wanbel
na gutpela taim bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim gutpela kaikai long tebol bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, sambai long N. na N., nau na long taim bihain.
Na helpim tupela long wokabaut long rot bilong pasin holi
inap long de tupela i ken kamap
long bikpela kaikai bilong yu long heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim famili

entrance.text:
Yu mas aninit long papa na mama bilong yu. Dispela em i namba wan
lo i gat promis i stap wantaim. Promis i tok olsem yu bai i stap gut, na
yu bai i stap longpela taim long graun.

items.collect:
God, long bikpela save bilong yu,
yu yet i bin kamapim pasin bilong famili i stap wantaim.
Mipela i pre, lukdaun long mipela, ol wokmanmeri bilong yu,
na harim ol pre bilong mipela.
Long Holi Famili bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
yu bin skulim mipela long ol pasin holi.
Helpim mipela long bihainim trupela laik
na ol gutpela pasin bilong ol insait long famili bilong mipela,
bai wanpela de mipela i ken kamap long haus bilong yu,
na amamas inap oltaim oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais
i save kisim bek mipela long yu.
Mipela i askim yu, helpim ol famili bilong mipela
long i stap strong long grasia na bel isi i kam long yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Ating wanpela mama inap long lustingting long
pikinini bilong em? Maski sapos wanpela mama inap long lustingting
long pikinini bilong em, tasol mi yet mi no inap lustingting long yu.”

items.postcommunion:
Papa bilong marimari, yu bin strongim mipela
long dispela Sakramen bilong heven.
Helpim mipela long bihainim gut ol pasin bilong Holi Famili,
bai mipela i ken winim ol hevi bilong dispela graun,
na wanpela de mipela i ken bung wantaim ol
long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim ol Relijis 1

entrance.text:
Yu mas hop long Bikpela, na bihainim stretpela pasin. Olsem na yu bai
i stap gut long graun, na painim bel isi. Yu mas amamas long Bikpela
tasol, na em bai i givim yu ol samting yu askim.

items.collect:
God, yu save kirapim ol gutpela mangal
insait long bel bilong ol manmeri,
na yu save inapim ol dispela gutpela mangal.
Stiaim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu
long wokabaut long rot bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Ol i laik givim ol yet olgeta long yu,
olsem na ol i bin lusim olgeta samting bilong ol.
Mipela i pre, bai ol i ken bihainim Krais gut.
Strongim ol long givim baksait long ol samting bilong graun,
bai ol i ken mekim gut wok bilong yu,
na ol i ken wok bilong helpim ol manmeri.
Na pulapim ol long daunpasin
na long spirit bilong i stap olsem tarangu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i ofarim ol dispela presen holi long yu.
Na mipela i pre, long strong bilong dispela ofa,
mekim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu i kamap holi.
Yu yet i bin bungim ol long nem bilong yu.
Strongim ol,
bai ol i ken inapim gut ol promis ol i bin mekim long yu.
Na helpim ol,
bai ol i ken mekim wok bilong yu wantaim daunpasin.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Ensel bilong Bikpela i tokim Elaija olsem, “Yu mas kirap na kaikai.
Long wanem, yu mas wokabaut longpela rot yet.”
O: Re 22:17, 20
Spirit wantaim meri bilong Pikinini Sipsip, tupela i tok, “Yu kam.
Amen. Bikpela Jisas, yu kam.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin mekim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu
i bung wantaim long laikim pasin bilong yu,
na ol i bin kisim wanpela Bret tasol.
Helpim ol long i stap wan,
bai ol i ken pulap long laikim pasin na long ol gutpela wok.
Na strongim ol,
bai ol i ken wokabaut oltaim long rot bilong ol pasin holi,
na i kamap gutpela witnes bilong Krais.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim ol Relijis 2

entrance.text:
Lukim, Bikpela, mi kam bilong bihainim laik bilong yu. Mi yet mi bin
promis olsem, na lo bilong yu i stap insait long lewa bilong mi.

items.collect:
Lord, yu gutpela na trupela God, na yu no save senis.
Mipela i laik tenkim yu long ol gutpela samting
yu bin givim long brata (susa) bilong mipela, N..
Tude em i kam bilong tokaut gen long “yesa” bilong em long yu.
Givim spirit bilong laikim pasin long em,
bai olgeta de em i ken wok strong bilong givim glori long yu,
na bilong helpim salvesen bilong olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela presen bilong sakrifais,
wantaim brata (susa) bilong mipela N..
Em i laik givim em yet gen long yu olsem gutpela ofa.
Long strong bilong Holi Spirit,
mekim em i kamap olsem piksa bilong Pikinini bilong yu yet.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Olsem wel abus i dai long dring wara na i wok long painim baret i gat
wara, olsem tasol sol bilong mi i mangal long yu, God bilong mi.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i amamas
long aniveseri bilong brata (susa) bilong mipela N.,
na mipela i bin kisim Bodi na Blut bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela kaikai na dring bilong heven,
i ken strongim brata (susa) bilong mipela
long wokabaut oltaim wantaim amamas long rot i go long yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong askim God long ol vokesen bilong relijis laip

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Sapos yu laik kamap stretpela olgeta, orait, yu
go na salim olgeta samting bilong yu, na givim long ol tarangu, na
bihainim mi.”

items.collect:
God Papa, yu holi, yu save singautim olgeta bilipmanmeri
long kamap holi long rot bilong bihainim laikim pasin.
Tasol yu save makim sampela man na meri,
bai ol i ken bihainim lek mak bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai ol dispela lain yu bin makim bilong yu yet,
i ken bihainim gutpela pasin oltaim.
Olsem na ol i ken kamap witnes bilong Kingdom bilong yu
long ai bilong Sios na long ai bilong olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
O, sapos Pris yet em i relijis:
Lord, lukdaun wantaim marimari
long dispela famili bilong yu,
na mekim em i gro wantaim ol nupela pikinini.
Mipela i pre,
bai em i ken helpim ol pikinini bilong em long kamap holi,
na bai ol pikinini i ken wokabaut oltaim
long rot bilong laikim pasin,
na long wok gut bilong helpim salvesen bilong olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God Papa, yu holi, marimari long mipela,
na kisim ol dispela presen mipela i laik ofarim long yu.
Mipela i pre, was gut long ol man na meri
i laik bihainim Pikinini bilong yu.
Na helpim ol long wokabaut oltaim long rot i go long heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Tru tumas, mi tokim yupela, ol man na meri i bin
lusim olgeta samting bilong ol na i bin bihainim mi, orait, ol bai i kisim
handet taim moa, na ol bai i kisim laip bilong oltaim.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, strongim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu
wantaim dispela kaikai na dring bilong heven.
Helpim ol, bai ol i ken bihainim gut Gutnius bilong yu,
na bai ol i ken kamap olsem piksa bilong Pikinini bilong yu
long ai bilong olgeta manmeri.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.
O, sapos Pris yet em i relijis:
Lord, long strong bilong dispela Sakramen,
helpim mipela long bihainim gut laik bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken givim witnes
bilong laikim pasin bilong yu long ai bilong olgeta manmeri,
na bai mipela i ken wok strong
bilong kisim ol samting bilong yu i no inap pinis.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong strongim pasin wanbel

entrance.text:
Olgeta bilipmanmeri i bin gat wanpela laik na wanpela tingting tasol. Ol
Aposel i givim witnes long Kirap Bek bilong Bikpela Jisas, na bikpela
grasia i stap wantaim ol. Aleluya.

items.collect:
God, yu Papa bilong kamapim pasin wanbel,
na yu Papa bilong laikim pasin.
Helpim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu
long bihainim wanpela laik na wanpela tingting tasol.
Olsem na Sios bilong yu i ken givim witnes long tok tru bilong yu,
na i ken sanap strong long pasin wanbel,
na long pasin bilong i stap wan.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, yu save mekim mipela i kamap nupela gen
long ol Sakramen na long ol lo bilong yu.
Olsem na yu helpim mipela long kamap olsem yu.
Marimari long mipela,
na stiaim wokabaut bilong mipela long rot bilong yu.
Na mekim bai dispela ofa bilong sakrifais
i ken helpim mipela long pulap long laikim pasin i kam long yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Papa, mi beten bilong helpim ol manmeri husat
bai i bilip long mi. Mi beten bai ol i ken i stap long mitupela, na bai ol
manmeri bilong graun i ken bilip olsem yu bin salim mi na mi kam.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim dispela Sakramen
bilong mekim olgeta manmeri i kamap wan wantaim yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long i stap wanbel insait long Sios bilong yu.
Na strongim bel isi bilong yu insait long mipela,
bai mipela i ken strongim bel isi bilong ol arapela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio bilong Misa bilong askim God long mekim ol Kristen i kamap wanlain, p 1062

own.title: Bodi bilong Krais em i wanpela tasol. Na Sios em i Bodi bilong Krais
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long wok bilong Krais,
yu bin mekim mipela i save long tok tru bilong yu.
Na yu laik bai wanpela bilip na wanpela Baptais tasol
i ken bungim mipela,
na mekim mipela i kamap Bodi bilong em yet.

Long wok bilong Krais, yu bin salim Holi Spirit bilong yu
i kam long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na Holi Spirit i save givim kain kain presen long ol bilipmanmeri,
bai ol i ken wok bung wantaim,
na bai ol i ken kamap wanpela lain tasol.
Na nau Holi Spirit i stap yet wantaim mipela, ol pikinini bilong yu,
na em i save givim laip na stiaim Sios bilong yu.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Misa bilong helpim pasin sekan i kamap

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Mi yet mi save kisim bek pipel bilong mi. Sapos
ol i singaut long mi long taim bilong hevi, bai mi harim krai bilong ol.
Na bai mi stap Bikpela bilong ol inap oltaim oltaim.”

items.collect:
God bilong marimari na bilong pasin sekan,
yu save givim spesol taim bilong salvesen
long pipel bilong yu,
bai ol i ken luksave olsem yu yet i bin kamapim ol,
na yu Papa bilong ol.
Marimari long mipela na helpim mipela
(long dispela gutpela taim),
bai mipela i ken save long bel isi bilong yu,
na bai mipela i ken wok wantaim yu
bilong mekim olgeta samting i kamap wanbel wantaim Krais.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
O, long taim bilong Ista:
God, yu tasol inap long mekim olgeta manmeri i kamap fri.
Na yu laik bungim olgeta manmeri long wanpela pipel tasol,
na mekim ol long lusim kalabus bilong sin.
(Na nau yu givim taim bilong grasia
na bilong blesing long mipela).
Helpim Sios bilong yu long gro long pasin bilong i stap fri,
bai em i ken kamap olsem mak bilong salvesen i kam long yu,
na bai em i ken soim olsem yu save laikim olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, Pikinini bilong yu em i as bilong bel isi bilong mipela,
na em yet i bin mekim mipela
i kamap wanbel gen wantaim yu.
Na long blut bilong em,
em i bin tekewe ol sin bilong olgeta manmeri bilong graun,
na em i bin mekim mipela i kamap fri.
Lukdaun long ol ofa bilong Sios bilong yu
(long dispela taim bilong amamas na bilong grasia bilong yu),
na helpim em long bringim dispela pasin bilong Krais
i go long olgeta manmeri.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela ol manmeri i save hatwok tru na i karim ol
bikpela hevi, yupela olgeta kam long mi, na bai mi givim malolo long
yupela.”

alt.text: Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i mas askim, na yupela bai i kisim, na amamas bai i pulap tru long bel bilong yupela.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i kisim pinis Sakramen bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Dispela Sakramen i save mekim mipela
i kamap wanbel wantaim yu.
Mipela i pre, bai em i ken pulapim mipela long laikim pasin,
na i ken strongim mipela long mekim wok
bilong bringim bel isi bilong yu i go long olgeta ples.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong askim God long mekim ol kristen i kamap wanlain 1

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Mi Gutpela Wasman bilong ol sipsip. Mi save
long ol sipsip bilong mi, na ol sipsip bilong mi ol i save long mi, olsem
Papa i save long mi, na mi save long Papa. Na mi lusim laip bilong mi
bilong helpim ol sipsip.”

items.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Yu save bungim ol samting i stap nabaut nabaut,
na yu save lukautim ol samting yu bungim pinis.
Marimari long ol lain sipsip bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Yu bin mekim ol i kamap holi long wanpela Baptais tasol.
Mekim ol i kamap wan long bilip
na long pasin bilong laikim yu na ol arapela manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, long sakrifais bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
yu bin kisim mipela olsem pipel bilong yu yet.
Mipela i askim yu,
givim pasin wanbel na gutpela taim long mipela
na long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.prefaceNote: Bodi bilong Krais em i wanpela tasol. Na Sios em i Bodi

communion.text:
Yumi planti, tasol yumi stap olsem wanpela bret na wanpela bodi tasol.
Long wanem, yumi olgeta i save kaikai long wanpela Bret na dring long
wanpela Kap.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela Santu Komunio, nau tasol mipela i kisim pinis,
em i mak bilong ol bilipmanmeri i stap wan wantaim yu.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela Santu Komunio
i ken mekim Sios bilong yu i kamap wanbel.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

own.title: Bodi bilong Krais em i wanpela tasol. Na Sios em i Bodi bilong Krais
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long wok bilong Krais,
yu bin mekim mipela i save long tok tru bilong yu.
Na yu laik bai wanpela bilip na wanpela Baptais tasol
i ken bungim mipela,
na mekim mipela i kamap Bodi bilong em yet.

Long wok bilong Krais, yu bin salim Holi Spirit bilong yu
i kam long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na Holi Spirit i save givim kain kain presen long ol bilipmanmeri,
bai ol i ken wok bung wantaim,
na bai ol i ken kamap wanpela lain tasol.
Na nau Holi Spirit i stap yet wantaim mipela, ol pikinini bilong yu,
na em i save givim laip na stiaim Sios bilong yu.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Misa bilong askim God long mekim ol kristen i kamap wanlain 2

entrance.text:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela, kisim bek mipela. Bungim mipela long
olgeta hap bilong graun, bai mipela i ken tokaut long nem holi bilong
yu, na amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu.

items.collect:
God, yu bin bungim planti lain manmeri,
long pasin bilong givim witnes long nem bilong yu.
Na yu bin singautim ol long kam long Kingdom bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
helpim mipela long laikim na bihainim oltaim ol lo bilong yu,
bai mipela i ken kamap wanlain tru long bilip
na long wokabaut bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.prefaceNote: Bodi bilong Krais em i wanpela tasol. Na Sios em i Bodi

own.title: Bodi bilong Krais em i wanpela tasol. Na Sios em i Bodi bilong Krais
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Long wok bilong Krais,
yu bin mekim mipela i save long tok tru bilong yu.
Na yu laik bai wanpela bilip na wanpela Baptais tasol
i ken bungim mipela,
na mekim mipela i kamap Bodi bilong em yet.

Long wok bilong Krais, yu bin salim Holi Spirit bilong yu
i kam long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na Holi Spirit i save givim kain kain presen long ol bilipmanmeri,
bai ol i ken wok bung wantaim,
na bai ol i ken kamap wanpela lain tasol.
Na nau Holi Spirit i stap yet wantaim mipela, ol pikinini bilong yu,
na em i save givim laip na stiaim Sios bilong yu.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Misa bilong telimautim Gutnius long olgeta lain pipel 1

entrance.text:
God, yu ken helpim mipela, na blesim mipela. Pes bilong yu i ken lait
long mipela, na yu ken marimari long mipela. Olsem na bai olgeta
manmeri bilong graun i ken save long rot bilong yu, na olgeta lain
pipel i ken save long salvesen i kam long yu.

items.collect:
God, yu laik kisim bek olgeta manmeri,
na yu laik long olgeta manmeri i ken painim tok i tru.
Lukdaun long ol bikpela lain manmeri
i no bin harim yet Gutnius bilong yu,
na salim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu i go long ol.
Strongim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu,
bai ol i ken telimautim Gutnius bilong yu
long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na helpim olgeta pipel bilong yu,
bai ol i ken bung long tok i gat laip,
na long strong bilong ol Sakramen.
Olsem na ol bai inap long wokabaut oltaim
long rot bilong salvesen na bilong laikim pasin.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, lukim pes bilong Krais bilong yu,
em i bin givim em yet olsem sakrifais
bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i pre, bai olgeta manmeri
bilong hap san i kamap inap long hap san i go daun,
i ken litimapim nem bilong yu namel long olgeta lain pipel,
na ol i ken ofarim wanpela sakrifais tasol long yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela lainim olgeta lain pipel long bihainim
olgeta tok mi bin givim long yupela. Lukim, mi stap wantaim yupela
olgeta de, i go inap long dispela taim i pinis.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim mipela
long Sakramen bilong kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai dispela Sakramen i ken strongim oltaim bilip bilong mipela,
na i ken helpim mipela long kisim laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong telimautim Gutnius long olgeta lain pipel 2

entrance.text:
Yupela i mas tokaut long glori bilong Bikpela long ol lain manmeri
bilong graun. Autim stori bilong ol bikpela wok bilong em long olgeta
pipel bilong graun. Long wanem, Bikpela i gat biknem, na olgeta
manmeri i mas litimapim nem bilong em.

items.collect:
God, yu laik bai Sios bilong yu i kamap olsem rot
bilong kisim bek olgeta pipel bilong graun.
Na yu laik bai wok ridima bilong Krais i ken i go het long Sios
inap long dispela graun i pinis.
Mipela i pre, kirapim tingting bilong ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu,
bai ol i ken mekim wok bilong kisim bek ol arapela manmeri.
Olsem na ol olgeta lain pipel bilong graun
i ken kamap pipel bilong yu yet, na wanpela famili tasol.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, dispela ofa na pre bilong Sios
i ken kamap long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre,
bai yu ken laikim ol dispela presen bilong Sios bilong yu,
wankain olsem yu bin laikim sakrifais
bilong Pen na Indai bilong Pikinini bilong yu
bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Yupela olgeta lain pipel, litimapim nem bilong Bikpela. Yupela olgeta
lain pipel, singsing amamas long em. Long wanem, oltaim em i save
marimari long yumi. Na stretpela pasin bilong Bikpela i save stap inap
oltaim.

alt.text: Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i mas i go long olgeta hap bilong graun, na autim Gutnius.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela kaikai mipela i bin kisim long tebol bilong yu,
i ken helpim mipela long kamap holi.
Yu bin makim Sios bilong yu long kamap olsem rot
bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i pre, bai olgeta manmeri bilong graun i ken amamas
long salvesen i kam long Diwai Kros bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim ol Kristen manmeri i kisim hevi long bilip bilong ol

entrance.text:
Bikpela, tingim kontrak bilong yu, na yu no ken lustingting long ol
tarangu manmeri bilong yu. Bikpela, yu kirap na helpim ol lain bilong
yu. Na yu no ken lustingting long singaut bilong ol manmeri i wok
long painim yu.

alt.text: Pita i stap long haus kalabus. Tasol oltaim ol manmeri bilong Sios i wok long pre long God bilong helpim em.

items.collect:
God, long bikpela save bilong yu,
yu laik bai Sios i mas karim pen wantaim Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, helpim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu
i wok long karim pen long nem bilong yu.
Givim spirit bilong bel isi na laikim pasin long ol.
Na strongim ol, bai ol i ken sanap strong,
na bai ol i ken kamap gutpela witnes bilong ol promis bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol dispela pre na ofa bilong sakrifais
long han bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu
i wok long karim hevi long bilip bilong ol,
ol i ken amamas long pas long sakrifais bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Strongim ol, bai ol i ken save
olsem yu bin raitim pinis nem bilong ol long heven,
wantaim ol manmeri yu bin makim pinis.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i ken amamas taim ol manmeri i tok nogut
long yupela, na ol i mekim nogut long yupela, long wanem yupela i
stap lain bilong mi. Yupela i ken amamas na belgut tru, long wanem,
pe bilong yupela em bai i bikpela long heven.”
O: Mt 10:32
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Man o meri i save tokim ol manmeri olsem em i
stap long lain bilong mi, mi tu bai mi tokim Papa bilong mi long heven
olsem dispela man o meri em i bilong mi.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, long dispela Sakramen,
strongim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu long tok i tru.
Na helpim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu i wok long karim pen,
bai ol i ken bihainim Pikinini bilong yu,
na karim diwai kros bilong ol yet.
Olsem na ol i ken amamas long i stap Kristen
namel long olgeta hevi bilong ol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa long taim bilong bung bilong ritrit o bilong pastoral wok

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Long ples tupela o tripela man i kam bung long
nem bilong mi, orait mi yet mi stap namel long ol.”

alt.text: Pasin bilong laikim wanpela narapela i winim olgeta arapela pasin, na em i inapim olgeta gutpela pasin wantaim. Yupela i mas larim bel isi bilong Krais i pulap long hat bilong yupela. Long dispela bel isi yupela i mas kamap wanpela bodi tasol.

items.collect:
Lord, givim spirit bilong gutpela save,
na bilong tok i tru, na bilong bel isi long mipela.
Helpim mipela long luksave long ol pasin yu save laikim.
Na strongim mipela, bai mipela olgeta i ken wok gut wantaim
bilong inapim ol dispela pasin.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, lukdaun wantaim marimari
long ol ofa bilong ol wokmanmeri bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, helpim ol wokmanmeri bilong yu,
bai ol i ken save gut long ol pasin yu save laikim,
na bai ol i ken givim witnes long ol samting i stret
long ai bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Long ples trupela laikim pasin i stap long em, God tu i stap long em.
Laikim pasin bilong Krais i bin bungim yumi wantaim.

items.postcommunion:
God bilong marimari,
mipela i kisim pinis ol holi presen bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong dispela Sakramen
i ken helpim mipela long bihainim laik bilong yu,
na long kamap witnes bilong tok i tru bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 2 bilong Holi Spirit, p 1135

own.title: Prefasio 2 bilong Holi Spirit
own.subtitle: Wok bilong Holi Spirit insait long Sios
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Yu save lukautim gut olgeta samting,
na yu save stiaim Sios bilong yu long kain kain rot.
Long strong bilong Holi Spirit,
oltaim yu save helpim Sios,
bai em i ken bihainim laik bilong yu tasol.
Olsem na long taim bilong hevi,
Sios i save singaut long helpim bilong yu.
Na long taim bilong amamas,
em i save tenkim yu,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Olsem na wantaim ol Ensel,
mipela i amamas long litimapim nem bilong yu,
na mipela i sing (tok):

groups.title: Ol Misa bilong helpim sindaun bilong pipel na kantri

items.title: Misa bilong helpim kantri o ples
items.collect:
God, yu save stiaim olgeta samting
long gutpela save na tingting bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, marimari long mipela,
na harim ol pre mipela i mekim
bilong helpim kantri (ples) bilong mipela.
Givim gutpela save long ol lida,
na gutpela pasin long ol manmeri,
bai ol i ken wok gut wantaim,
na olgeta manmeri i ken painim gutpela sindaun na bel isi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim ol manmeri i holim wok gavman
items.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta na yu stap oltaim.
Lewa bilong ol manmeri i stap long han bilong yu tasol.
Yu tasol i save givim namba long ol manmeri,
bai ol i ken mekim wok gavman.
Mipela i pre, lukdaun long ol manmeri i holim wok gavman.
Helpim ol, bai olgeta lain manmeri bilong graun i ken i stap gut,
na painim gutpela taim, na bai ol i ken i stap fri
bilong skelim wanem lotu ol i laik bihainim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim ol memba bilong palamen
items.collect:
God, yu save stiaim na lukautim gut olgeta samting.
Mipela i askim yu, lukdaun wantaim marimari
long ol memba bilong Palamen.
Salim spirit bilong gutpela save i kam long ol,
bai ol i ken mekim wok bilong bringim gutpela taim
na bel isi long olgeta manmeri,
na bai ol i no ken givim baksait long laik bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

items.title: Misa bilong helpim praim minista o gavana
items.collect:
God, olgeta gavman na bikman bilong graun
i mas aninit long yu.
Nau mipela i pre bilong helpim wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu
(Praim Minista o Gavana) N.,
bai em i ken inapim gut wok bilong em.
Helpim em long i stap aninit long yu oltaim,
na long mekim ol wok yu save laikim,
bai em i ken strongim pasin bel isi namel long ol pipel,
na mekim ol i stap fri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

items.title: Misa long bigin bilong ol ektiviti bilong nupela yia

entrance.text:
Yu save blesim olgeta yia wantaim ol gutpela pasin bilong yu. Oltaim
yu save givim planti gutpela samting long mipela.

alt.text: Bikpela i tok olsem, “Lukim, mi stap wantaim yupela olgeta de, i go inap long dispela taim i pinis.”

items.collect:
God, yu no gat bigin bilong yu, na yu no gat pinis bilong yu tu.
Yu tasol i bin kamapim olgeta samting.
Nau mipela i laik givim dispela nupela yia long yu.
Na mipela i askim yu,
bai yu ken givim planti gutpela samting long mipela,
na helpim mipela long wokabaut long rot bilong ol pasin holi.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i amamas long bigin bilong dispela nupela yia,
na mipela i bringim ol ofa bilong sakrifais i kam long yu.
Mipela i pre, kisim ol dispela presen,
na mekim ol i kamap stret long ai bilong yu.
Na helpim mipela, bai mipela i ken wokabaut oltaim
long rot bilong laikim pasin bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Jisas Krais i save stap wankain tasol, long asde, na long tude, na inap
oltaim.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, nau tasol pipel bilong yu i kisim pinis
dispela holi Sakramen.
Mipela i pre, stap klostu long ol namel long dispela yia.
Na helpim ol, bai i no gat wanpela samting nogut
i ken kamap long ol manmeri i save trastim yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong askim God long blesim wok bilong ol manmeri 1

entrance.text:
Bipo bipo tru, God i mekim heven na graun i kamap. Na God i mekim
man i kamap, olsem piksa bilong em yet. Na God i lukim ol dispela
samting em i bin mekim, na em i gutpela tru.

alt.text: Bikpela, karamapim mipela long blesing bilong yu. Na mekim olgeta wok bilong han bilong mipela i kamap gutpela.

items.collect:
God, yu yet i bin wokim olgeta samting,
na yu laik bai olgeta manmeri i mekim gut wok bilong ol.
Nau mipela i laik kirapim wok bilong mipela.
Na mipela i pre, bai dispela wok bilong mipela
i ken helpim sindaun bilong mipela hia long graun,
na i ken mekim Kingdom bilong Krais
i kamap namel long olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, dispela ofa em i kaikai i save strongim mipela,
na em i Sakramen i save mekim mipela i kamap nupela gen.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i no ken sot long strong bilong bodi
na long strong bilong sol i kam long dispela ofa.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Olgeta samting yupela i mekim long tok o long pasin, em yupela i mas
mekim long nem bilong Bikpela Jisas Krais. Na long nem bilong em,
yupela i mas tenkyu long God Papa.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim kaikai long tebol bilong laikim pasin
na bilong pasin wanbel bilong yu.
Nau mipela i singaut long marimari bilong yu,
na mipela i pre, bai dispela wok, yu bin givim mipela long mekim,
i ken helpim laip bilong mipela hia long graun.
Na em i ken helpim mipela tu long trastim yu,
na long kamapim Kingdom bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 5 bilong ol Sande bilong Taim bilong Yia, p 514
Prefasio 5 bilong ol Sande bilong Taim bilong Yia, p 514

items.title: Misa bilong askim God long blesim wok bilong ol manmeri 2
items.collect:
God, yu givim wok long mipela ol manmeri
bilong bosim olgeta samting yu bin mekim kamap.
Mipela i pre, marimari long mipela,
na helpim mipela long bihainim pasin Kristen
long olgeta wok bilong mipela.
Na mekim bai wok bilong mipela
i ken helpim ol bratasusa long bihainim laikim pasin,
na long mekim olgeta samting yu bin wokim long graun
i kamap gutpela moa yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, kisim ol ofa na pre bilong Sios bilong yu.
Na mipela i laik ofarim tu ol wok bilong mipela i go long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai ol wok bilong mipela
i ken helpim mipela long pas wantaim wok ridima bilong Krais.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin mekim mipela i kamap nupela gen
long dispela Sakramen bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre, bai yu ken helpim mipela long dispela graun,
na stiaim oltaim wokabaut bilong mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 5 bilong ol Sande bilong Taim bilong Yia, p. 514.

items.title: Misa long taim bilong planim kaikai 1

entrance.text:
Bikpela, karamapim mipela long blesing bilong yu. Na mekim olgeta
wok bilong han bilong mipela i kamap gutpela.

items.collect:
God, long helpim bilong yu,
mipela i save planim ol pikinini kaikai long graun.
Na long strong bilong yu,
yu save mekim ol pikinini kaikai i gro na i karim gutpela kaikai.
Mipela i save olsem, wok bilong mipela tasol i no inap.
Long wanem,
yu tasol inap long mekim olgeta samting i gro na i karim kaikai.
Mipela i pre, bai yu ken helpim wok bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
