own.title: Wok misin bilong Jon bilong Baptais bilong i go pas long Ridima
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela,
long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Santu Jon bilong Baptais i bin i go pas long Krais,
bilong redim rot bilong em.
Olsem na mipela i litimapim nem bilong yu,
long wanem, yu bin makim em bilong mekim dispela wok.
Na yu bin givim biknem long em
i winim nem bilong ol arapela manmeri.

Bikpela amamas i kamap taim mama i bin karim em.
Na taim em i stap yet long bel bilong mama,
em i bin amamas na kalap,
long wanem, salvesen bilong ol manmeri klostu i laik kam.

Na namel long ol profet, Jon wanpela tasol
i bin soim Lem bilong God i kam pinis
bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri.

Krais i bin kamapim Sakramen bilong Baptais,
tasol Jon i baptaisim em.
Na taim em i mekim olsem, wara i kamap holi.
Na bihain Jon i bin kapsaitim blut bilong em,
bilong givim witnes long Krais.

Olsem na wantaim ol strongpela Ensel bilong heven,
mipela hia long graun i litimapim nem bilong yu,
na oltaim mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Santu Josep

entrance.text:
Lukim dispela wokman i gat gutpela tingting, na i save gut long wok
bilong em. Bikpela i bin makim em bilong bosim famili bilong em.

items.collect:
God, long gutpela save bilong yu, yu bin makim Santu Josep
bilong kamap man bilong Santu Maria,
em i Mama bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Santu Josep
i ken helpim mipela long heven.
Long wanem, mipela i save litimapim nem bilong em
olsem wasman bilong mipela hia long graun.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God Papa, yu holi, mipela i laik ofarim dispela sakrifais
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Santu Josep
i ken helpim mipela oltaim.
Long wanem, yu bin makim em olsem papa
bilong lukautim Pikinini bilong yu hia long graun.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.prefaceNote: Wok misin bilong Santu Josep

communion.text:
Yu gutpela wokman, yu bin mekim gutpela wok tru. Yu save lukautim
gut wok bilong yu. Yu kam amamas wantaim Bikpela bilong yu.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela Sakramen
i bin givim nupela strong na laip long mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken bihainim ol pasin holi na stret tasol.
Na ol pre na pasin bilong Santu Josep i ken helpim mipela oltaim.
Long wanem, em i stretpela man, na man bilong harim tok,
na oltaim em i bin bihainim laik bilong yu tasol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

own.title: Wok misin bilong Santu Josep
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i mas singsing amamas long yu,
onarim yu, na litimapim nem bilong yu,
long dispela de bilong tingim Santu Josep.

Santu Josep em i stretpela man,
na yu bin givim em olsem man long Santu Maria Virgo,
em i Mama bilong God.
Yu bin makim em, bai em i ken lukautim famili bilong yu,
na bai em i ken was olsem papa long Jisas Krais,
em i Pikinini bilong yu na Bikpela bilong mipela,
na em i bin kamap man long strong bilong Holi Spirit.

Long em, ol Ensel i presim glori bilong yu.
Ol Dominion i adorim yu,
na ol strongpela lain bilong heven i guria long ai bilong yu.
Heven wantaim ol strongpela lain bilong heven,
na ol Serafim i litimapim nem bilong yu
wantaim bikpela amamas.
Na mipela tu i laik bung wantaim ol
na givim ona long yu, na mipela i sing (tok):

items.title: Olgeta Santu Aposel

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i no bin makim mi bilong i stap wantaim
yupela. Nogat. Mi bin makim yupela bilong i stap ol lain bilong mi. Na
mi bin givim wok long yupela, bai yupela i ken i go na karim kaikai, na
bai kaikai bilong yupela i ken i stap gut.”

items.collect:
Lord, Sios bilong yu i mas amamas oltaim
long bikpela nem bilong ol Santu Aposel.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai ol Aposel i ken stiaim wokabaut bilong Sios oltaim.
Long wanem, ol skul na ol gutpela pasin bilong ol
i save givim amamas long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, yu bin salim Holi Spirit i kam long ol Aposel bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, salim dispela Spirit i kam long mipela tu,
bai em i ken helpim mipela long luksave long ol bikpela samting
mipela i bin kisim long han bilong ol Aposel.
Na Holi Spirit i ken helpim mipela long ofarim dispela sakrifais
bilong givim glori long yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela ol man i bin bihainim mi, yupela bai i
sindaun long 12-pela sia king, na yupela bai i kotim ol 12-pela lain
bilong Israel.”

items.postcommunion:
God, mipela i pre,
strongim mipela na klinim hat bilong mipela,
bai mipela i ken painim amamas tasol
long bihainim ol skul bilong ol Aposel,
na long pasin bilong brukim bret, na long pasin bilong beten.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 1 o 2 bilong ol Aposel, p 522-523

items.title: Santu Pita na Pol, Aposel

entrance.text:
Pita, hetman bilong ol Aposel, na Pol, tisa bilong ol lain pipel, tupela i
bin skulim mipela long lo bilong yu, Bikpela.

items.collect:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Long wok bilong tupela Aposel Santu Pita na Pol,
yu bin mekim Sios bilong yu i sanap strong.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong tupela i ken strongim mipela,
na i ken helpim Sios bilong yu
long wokabaut oltaim long rot bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i litimapim nem bilong tupela Aposel,
Santu Pita na Pol,
na mipela i bringim ol ofa i kam long alta bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, yu no ken skelim ol wok bilong mipela,
long wanem, mipela yet i no gat strong.
Tasol mekim mipela i amamas long marimari bilong yu
i save kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.prefaceNote: Tupela wok misin bilong Pita na Pol bilong helpim Sios

communion.text:
“Saimon, pikinini bilong Jon, ating yu laikim mi moa long ol dispela
man, a?” “Bikpela, yu save long olgeta samting. Yu save, mi laikim yu.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i pre,
bai dispela Sakramen bilong heven
i ken strongim ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu.
Long wanem,
ol i bin kisim lait bilong bilip long skul bilong ol Aposel.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

own.title: Tupela wok misin bilong Pita na Pol bilong helpim Sios
own.text:
Tru, em i gutpela na i stret,
oltaim na long olgeta ples,
mipela i tenkim yu, Lord, yu Papa na yu holi tru,
yu strong olgeta na yu God bilong oltaim.
Givim tenkyu long yu em i wok bilong mipela,
na em i kisim bek mipela.

Yu mekim mipela i amamas
long tingim tupela Aposel, Santu Pita na Pol.
Pita i go pas long autim bilip long Krais.
Na Pol i tokaut long dispela bilip long ai bilong olgeta manmeri.
Pita i kirapim namba wan Sios,
namel long ol manmeri bilong Israel.
Na Pol em i bikpela tisa
i skulim ol manmeri bilong ol arapela lain.

Wan wan i gat rot bilong em yet,
tasol tupela wantaim i bin kamapim wanpela famili bilong Krais.
Tupela wantaim i bin kisim biknem long olgeta hap bilong graun.
Na tupela wantaim i bin kisim pe bilong ol Martir long heven.

Olsem na wantaim ol Santu na ol Ensel,
mipela i givim ona long yu, na oltaim mipela sing (tok):

items.title: Santu Pita, Aposel

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tokim Saimon Pita olsem, “Mi pre pinis bilong helpim yu, bai
bilip bilong yu i no ken pundaun. Na taim yu tanim na yu kam bek,
orait, yu mas strongim ol brata bilong yu.”

items.collect:
God, yu bin givim ol ki bilong Kingdom bilong Heven
long Santu Aposel bilong yu, Pita.
Na yu givim wok Pris long em, bilong pasim na lusim ol samting.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long kamap fri long ol rop i save pasim mipela long sin.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, yu yet i bin skulim Aposel Santu Pita,
na em i tokaut olsem, yu God i gat laip,
na Krais em i Pikinini bilong yu.
Na bihain em i bin givim witnes long Tisa bilong em,
na em tu i karim pen na i dai.
Tude mipela i tingim em, na mipela i askim yu,
bai yu ken amamas long kisim dispela ofa bilong pipel bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Pita i tokim Jisas olsem, “Yu Krais, yu Pikinini bilong God i gat laip.”
Na Jisas i bekim tok long em olsem, “Yu Pita, na bai mi wokim Sios
bilong mi antap long dispela ston.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Aposel Santu Pita,
na yu bin givim kaikai bilong laip bilong oltaim long mipela.
Mipela i amamas na mipela i pre,
helpim mipela long pas tru wantaim Pikinini bilong yu.
Long wanem, tok bilong em tasol i save givim laip.
Na strongim mipela, bai mipela i ken wokabaut oltaim
olsem gutpela sipsip bilong yu,
na kamap long gutpela ples bilong yu long heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 1 bilong ol Aposel, p 522

items.title: Santu Pol, Aposel

entrance.text:
Mi save long dispela man mi bin bilip long em. Na mi save gut olsem,
em i strong tumas, na em inap long lukautim pe bilong mi inap long de
em yet i bin makim. Em yet em i stretpela jas.

items.collect:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Yu bin makim Aposel Santu Pol bilong autim Gutnius,
na em i bin autim dispela tok long ai bilong ol bikman
na bilong ol pipel.
Mipela i pre, bai olgeta manmeri bilong graun
i ken bilipim dispela tok bilong em,
na Sios bilong yu i ken gro na i kamap strong.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, tude mipela i tingim Aposel Santu Pol,
na mipela i selebretim dispela Sakramen bilong heven.
Holi Spirit i bin pulapim em long lait bilong bilip,
olsem na em i bin tokaut long glori bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai Holi Spirit i ken pulapim mipela tu long dispela lait.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Mi stap laip long bilip bilong Pikinini bilong God. Em i bin laikim mi
tru, na em i lusim laip bilong em yet bilong helpim mi.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim mipela long Bodi na Blut
bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, bai Krais i ken i stap laip insait long mipela,
bai i no gat wanpela samting i ken pulim mipela i go longwe
long laikim pasin bilong em,
na bai mipela i ken harim ol skul bilong Aposel Pol,
na wokabaut oltaim long rot bilong laikim ol bratasusa.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 1 bilong ol Aposel, p 522

items.title: Wanpela Santu Aposel

entrance.text:
Olgeta de yupela i mas tokaut long God i bin kisim bek yumi. Yupela i
mas stori long glori bilong em long olgeta lain pipel.

items.collect:
Lord, Aposel Santu N. i bin bilip long Pikinini bilong yu,
na em i bihainim em gut.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong em
i ken strongim bilip bilong mipela,
na i ken mekim Sios bilong yu
i kamap Sakramen bilong kisim bek olgeta manmeri bilong graun.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i tingim Aposel Santu N.,
na mipela i bringim ol dispela presen i kam long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai pasin bilong em i ken helpim mipela
long bihainim Gutnius bilong Krais long wokabaut bilong mipela,
na long mekim wok bilong autim bilip.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Papa bilong mi, em i givim Kingdom long mi.
Olsem tasol mi givim Kingdom long yupela. Na long Kingdom bilong
mi, yupela bai i sindaun long tebol bilong mi, na kaikai na dring.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i selebretim pestode bilong Aposel Santu N.,
na mipela i bin kisim promis bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai dispela Sakramen i ken helpim mipela long dispela laip,
na i ken bringim mipela long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 2 bilong ol Aposel, p 523

items.title: Olgeta Santu

entrance.text:
Sol bilong ol Santu i amamas long heven. Ol Santu i bin laikim Krais
tru, na ol i bin bihainim lek mak bilong em. Olsem na nau ol i singaut
amamas wantaim Krais inap oltaim.

items.collect:
God, yu as na Papa bilong olgeta pasin i holi.
Taim ol Santu i bin wokabaut long dispela graun,
yu bin givim kain kain grasia long ol.
Na taim ol i kamap long heven,
yu bin givim wankain glori tasol long ol.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai pre bilong ol i ken helpim mipela long wokabaut gut
long rot yu yet i bin makim bilong mipela wan wan.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i laik onarim olgeta Santu,
na mipela i bringim dispela ofa i kam long yu.
Mipela i bilip olsem ol Santu i kisim pinis laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre, bai mipela i ken pilim helpim bilong pre bilong ol.
Long wanem, ol i save pre bilong helpim mipela
long kamap long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Ol manmeri bel bilong ol i klin, em ol i ken amamas. Long wanem,
ol bai i lukim God. Ol manmeri i save wok bilong mekim bel isi na
gutpela sindaun i kamap, em ol i ken amamas. Long wanem, ol bai i
kolim ol pikinini bilong God. Ol manmeri i save bihainim stretpela
pasin na long dispela as ol i kisim hevi long ol arapela, em ol i ken
amamas. Long wanem, Kingdom bilong Heven em i bilong ol.

items.postcommunion:
God, yu save mekim mipela i kamap nupela gen
long wanpela Bret,
na yu save strongim mipela long wanpela hop.
Mipela i pre,
helpim mipela long kamap wanpela bodi na wanpela spirit
wantaim Krais na wantaim ol Santu,
bai mipela tu i ken kirap bek long glori bilong em.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio 1 o 2 bilong ol Santu, p 524-525

sections.title: OL MISA BILONG HELPIM OL MANMERI I DAI PINIS

groups.title: Ol Misa bilong planim ol daimanmeri

items.title: Ausait long Taim bilong Ista

entrance.text:
Bikpela, givim malolo bilong oltaim long ol, na lait bilong oltaim i ken
lait long ol.

alt.text: Bikpela, givim malolo bilong oltaim long em, na lait bilong oltaim i ken lait long em.

items.collect:
God Papa, yu strong olgeta,
bilip bilong mipela i tokaut olsem
Pikinini bilong yu i bin dai na kirap bek.
Mipela i askim yu,
marimari long wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N.,
em i bin slip long Krais.
Na long strong bilong dispela Sakramen,
helpim em long kirap bek wantaim Krais,
na kisim amamas bilong oltaim.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i ofarim dispela ofa bilong sakrifais
bilong helpim wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N..
Marimari long em, na kisim bek em.
Em i bin bilip long Pikinini bilong yu em i Sevia bilong em.
Mipela i pre, bai Pikinini bilong yu i ken marimari long em
long taim bilong Kot.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

communion.text:
Bikpela, lait bilong oltaim i ken lait long ol inap oltaim, wantaim ol
Santu bilong yu. Long wanem, yu pulap long marimari. Bikpela, givim
malolo bilong oltaim long ol, na lait bilong oltaim i ken lait long ol,
wantaim ol Santu bilong yu. Long wanem, yu pulap long marimari.

alt.text: Bikpela, lait bilong oltaim i ken lait long em inap oltaim, wantaim ol Santu bilong yu. Long wanem, yu pulap long marimari. Bikpela, givim malolo bilong oltaim long em, na lait bilong oltaim i ken lait long em, wantaim ol Santu bilong yu. Long wanem, yu pulap long marimari.

items.postcommunion:
God, yu Bikpela bilong mipela.
Pikinini bilong yu i bin givim Sakramen
bilong Bodi bilong em yet long mipela,
olsem kaikai bilong strongim mipela,
taim mipela i wokabaut yet long dispela graun.
Strong bilong dispela Sakramen i ken helpim
brata (susa) bilong mipela N.
long kamap long bikpela kaikai bilong Krais i stap oltaim.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

refs: Prefasio bilong ol manmeri i dai pinis, p 536-540
Prefasio bilong ol manmeri i dai pinis, p 536-540

items.title: Long Taim bilong Ista

entrance.text:
Jisas i bin dai na i kirap bek gen. Olsem na long strong bilong Jisas,
God bai i kirapim ol manmeri i slip long matmat, na bringim ol i go
wantaim em. Tru, olgeta manmeri bilong lain bilong Adam i save dai.
Olsem tasol olgeta manmeri bilong lain bilong Krais bai i kisim laip
gen. Aleluya.

items.collect:
Lord, marimari long mipela, na harim ol pre bilong mipela.
Mipela i bilip long Pikinini bilong yu i kirap long indai.
Mipela i pre, strongim hop bilong mipela,
bai mipela i ken wet long kirap bek bilong N.,
em i wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, long dispela Sakramen,
mipela i kamap wan wantaim Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, lukdaun long ol ofa bilong mipela,
na bringim wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N. i dai pinis
i go long glori bilong Krais.
Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Kirap bek, em mi yet. Na laip, em mi yet. Na
man o meri i bilip long mi, maski sapos em i dai, em bai i stap laip yet.
Na olgeta manmeri i stap laip na i bilip long mi, bai ol i no i dai inap
oltaim.” Aleluya.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin selebretim dispela Sakramen
bilong Pen na Indai na Kirap Bek bilong Krais,
bilong helpim wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N. i dai pinis.
Mipela i askim yu,
bringim em i go long ples bilong lait na bilong bel isi bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

refs: Prefasio bilong ol manmeri i dai pinis, p 536-540

items.title: Ol arapela pre bilong Misa long taim bilong planim ol daimanmeri
items.collect:
God, yu tasol inap long givim laip gen
bihain long indai bilong mipela.
Mipela i askim yu,
lusim ol sin bilong wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N..
Em i bin bilip long Kirap Bek bilong Krais.
Olsem na taim olgeta manmeri bai i kirap bek,
mekim em i bung wantaim yu long glori bilong heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, yu strong olgeta, na yu pulap long marimari.
Mipela i pre, bai dispela ofa bilong sakrifais
i ken tekewe ol sin bilong wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N.
i dai pinis, na mekim em i kamap klin long Blut bilong Krais.
Long wanem, oltaim yu save marimari long ol manmeri
i bin kamap klin long wara bilong Baptais.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i kisim pinis
dispela Sakramen bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i bin givim laip bilong em yet olsem sakrifais
bilong helpim mipela,
na bihain em i kirap bek na i pulap long glori.
Mipela i askim yu,
marimari long wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N. i dai pinis.
Dispela Sakramen bilong Pen na Indai na Kirap Bek bilong Krais
i ken klinim ol sin bilong em,
na i ken bringim em long glori bilong kirap bek.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong planim wanpela pikinini i bin kisim Baptais pinis

entrance.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Yupela i gat blesing bilong Papa bilong mi. Yupela
kam kisim kingdom, Papa i bin redim, na i makim bilong yupela pinis,
long taim graun i kamap nupela yet.” (Aleluya)

items.collect:
God bilong marimari, save bilong yu i no gat arere bilong em.
Yu bin singautim dispela pikinini i kam long yu,
taim em i liklik yet.
Long Baptais yu bin givim grasia long em,
na yu bin mekim em i kamap pikinini bilong yu.
Nau mipela i bilip olsem em i stap pinis long Kingdom bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, harim ol pre bilong mipela, na helpim mipela,
bai wanpela de mipela i ken bung wantaim em
long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mekim holi ol dispela presen,
mipela i bringim i kam long yu.
Pastaim yu bin givim dispela pikinini long papamama bilong em,
na nau papamama i givim pikinini i go bek long yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai dispela ofa i ken helpim papamama
long bungim pikinini bilong tupela gen
long amamas bilong Kingdom bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Long Baptais yumi bin pas wantaim indai bilong Krais, na God i planim
yumi wantaim Krais long matmat. Yumi bilip tru, yumi bai i stap laip
tu wantaim Krais. (Aleluya)

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim mipela
long Sakramen bilong Bodi na Blut bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, givim bel isi long ol manmeri i krai sori,
na strongim hop bilong ol,
bai ol i ken bilip tru long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Misa bilong planim wanpela pikinini i no bin kisim Baptais yet

entrance.text:
God bai i mekim drai olgeta aiwara bilong ai bilong ol. Na ol bai i no
inap dai moa, o bel hevi. Na ol bai i no inap krai, o karim pen. Nogat.
Long wanem, ol samting bilong bipo em i pinis olgeta.

items.collect:
Lord, harim ol pre bilong ol bilipmanmeri bilong yu.
Ol i singaut long yu, long wanem,
ol i sori long pikinini bilong ol i lusim ol pinis.
Mipela i askim yu, strongim bilip na hop bilong ol,
bai ol i ken trastim marimari bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, kisim dispela ofa bilong mipela,
olsem mak bilong laikim pasin bilong mipela i go long yu.
Mipela i bilip long bikpela save na marimari bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, givim bel isi long mipela,
na mekim gut long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela bai i pinisim indai olgeta. God bai i mekim drai olgeta aiwara
bilong pes bilong ol manmeri.

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim mipela
long Sakramen bilong Bodi na Blut bilong Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, givim bel isi long ol manmeri i krai sori,
na strongim hop bilong ol,
bai ol i ken bilip tru long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.collect:
God, yu save givim glori long ol bilipmanmeri,
na yu save givim laip long ol manmeri bilong stretpela pasin.
Long Indai na Kirap Bek bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
yu bin kisim bek mipela.

Lord, dispela holi Sakramen
i bin givim nupela strong long mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N.
i ken kamap klin long ol sin bilong em,
na i ken kisim presen bilong laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i bin kisim kaikai bilong givim strong

groups.title: Ol arapela Misa bilong helpim ol manmeri i dai pinis

items.title: Misa bilong helpim wanpela man o meri i dai pinis

entrance.text:
Bikpela i ken opim dua bilong paradais long em, bai em i ken kam bek
long ples tru bilong em. Long dispela ples i no gat indai, na amamas
bilong oltaim i no save pinis.

items.collect:
God Papa, yu strong olgeta.
Yu bin strongim mipela
long misteri bilong Diwai Kros bilong Pikinini bilong yu,
na yu bin promisim mipela long pas
long misteri bilong Kirap Bek bilong em.
Mipela i pre, marimari long mipela,
na mekim bai wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N.
i ken bung long heven wantaim ol manmeri yu bin makim pinis
bilong yu yet.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, lukdaun wantaim marimari
long wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N..
Mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais bilong helpim em
na bilong litimapim nem bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bai dispela ofa i ken helpim em,
na yu ken kirapim em long laip bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

communion.text:
Bikpela i tok olsem, “Olgeta manmeri Papa i givim long mi, ol bai i kam
long mi. Na man o meri i kam long mi, mi no inap tru long rausim em.”

items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin strongim mipela
long dispela Sakramen bilong givim laip.
Bipo yu bin mekim wanpela kontrak
wantaim brata (susa) bilong mipela N..
Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong dispela Sakramen
i ken klinim sol bilong em, na i ken bringim em
i go insait long bel isi na amamas bilong Krais inap oltaim.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

groups.title: Ol kain kain pre bilong helpim ol manmeri i dai pinis

items.title: Bilong helpim Pop
items.collect:
God, yu save givim gutpela pe
long ol manmeri i bin mekim wok bilong yu.
Na yu bin makim wokman bilong yu, Pop N.,
bilong kisim ples bilong Pita olsem Wasman bilong Sios bilong yu.
Em i bin mekim gut wok bilong yu hia long graun,
na em i bin givim ol Sakramen bilong grasia
na bilong marimari bilong yu long olgeta manmeri.
Mipela i askim yu, bringim em i go long heven,
bai em i ken sanap long ai bilong yu, na amamas inap oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, dispela pre na ofa bilong mipela
i ken helpim sol bilong wokman bilong yu, Pop N.
long kisim gutpela pe long heven.
Mipela i askim yu, marimari long mipela tu,
na salim grasia bilong yu i kam long mipela.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
Lord, yu bin mekim mipela i kamap nupela gen
long dispela Sakramen bilong heven.
Yu bin makim wokman bilong yu, Pop N.,
bilong bungim olgeta bilipmanmeri
insait long wanpela Sios tasol.
Mipela i pre, marimari long em,
na bungim em wantaim ol lain sipsip bilong yu i stap long heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Bilong helpim wanpela Bisop
items.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
mipela i pre bilong helpim sol
bilong wokman bilong yu, Bisop N., i dai pinis.
Yu bin makim em bilong lukautim famili bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu, bekim ol gutpela wok bilong em,
na bringim em i go long heven,
bai em i ken amamas inap oltaim wantaim Bikpela bilong em.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, taim wokman bilong yu, Bisop N. i bin i stap laip,
em yet i bin ofarim dispela sakrifais long yu,
bilong helpim salvesen bilong ol bilipmanmeri.
Mipela i pre, bai long strong bilong dispela Misa,
yu ken marimari long em, na pogivim ol sin bilong em.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
God, yu strong olgeta, na yu pulap long marimari.

Em i stap laip na em i King, nau na oltaim.

em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
God, mipela i kisim pinis

Nau mipela i pre bilong helpim wokman na Pris bilong yu N..
Yu bin makim em bilong lukautim wok bilong yu hia long graun.

na kisim em i go long heven, bai em i ken lukim yu tru.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

God bilong oltaim.

Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

bai dispela sakrifais i ken helpim wokman bilong yu, Diken N..
Yu bin singautim em bilong mekim wok
insait long Sios bilong yu.
Helpim em long winim strong bilong indai,
na bringim em i go insait long amamas bilong yu
wantaim ol gutpela wokman bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Bilong helpim wanpela Relijis
items.collect:
God, yu strong olgeta,
mipela i pre bilong helpim sol
bilong wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N..
Em i bin givim em yet olgeta long Krais,
na em i bin bihainim Krais long rot bilong laikim pasin.
Mipela i askim yu, marimari long em,
na mekim em i amamas long lukim gori bilong yu,
wantaim ol brata (sista) bilong em, long Kingdom bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

items.title: Bilong helpim wanpela man o meri i bin wok long autim Gutnius
items.collect:
Lord, mipela i pre
bilong helpim wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N..
Em i bin wok hat bilong autim Gutnius bilong yu
long olgeta manmeri. Mipela i askim yu, marimari long em,
na givim gutpela pe long em long Kingdom bilong yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

items.title: Bilong helpim wanpela yangpela man o meri
items.collect:
God bilong marimari,
yu bin makim wokman bilong yu,
Diken N., bilong mekim wok insait long Sios bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, marimari long em,
na givim amamas bilong oltaim long sol bilong em.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais,
bai yu ken givim laip bilong oltaim
long wokman bilong yu, Diken N..
Taim em i bin i stap laip,
em i bin mekim wok bilong Krais, Pikinini bilong yu.
Mipela i pre, kirapim em wantaim ol gutpela wokman bilong yu,
long glori bilong oltaim long heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
Lord, mipela i kisim pinis ol holi presen bilong yu.
Mipela i askim yu,
bai dispela sakrifais i ken helpim wokman bilong yu, Diken N..
Yu bin singautim em bilong mekim wok
insait long Sios bilong yu.
Helpim em long winim strong bilong indai,
na bringim em i go insait long amamas bilong yu
wantaim ol gutpela wokman bilong yu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Bilong helpim wanpela man o meri i bin sik longpela taim
items.collect:
God, wokman (wokmeri) bilong yu N.,
i bin karim bikpela pen, na em i bin sik longpela taim.
Na long dispela rot, em i bin mekim wok bilong yu.
Long wanem, em i bin bihainim Pikinini bilong yu
long rot bilong karim pen.
Mipela i pre, givim gutpela pe long em,
na bringim em i go insait long glori bilong heven wantaim Krais.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

items.title: Bilong helpim wanpela man o meri i bin dai wantu tasol
items.collect:
Lord, mipela i krai sori long indai
bilong brata (susa) bilong mipela, N., i bin dai wantu tasol.
Olsem na mipela i pre,
soim strong bilong marimari bilong yu long mipela.
Na strongim mipela, bai mipela i ken trastim yu,
na bai mipela i ken bilip olsem em i stap pinis wantaim yu.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

items.title: Bilong helpim tupela marit
items.collect:
Lord, marimari long tupela wokmanmeri bilong yu, N. na N.,
na lusim ol sin bilong tupela.
Yu bin mekim tupela i laikim wanpela narapela
long dispela graun, na tupela i bin kamap wanpela bodi tasol.
Mipela i pre, bai laikim pasin bilong yu i ken bungim tupela gen
long laip bilong oltaim long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.

items.title: Bilong helpim papamama bilong Pris
items.collect:
God, yu bin skulim mipela
long pasin bilong onarim papa na mama.
Mipela i pre, marimari long papa na mama bilong mi(pela),
lusim ol sin bilong tupela,
na wanpela de bringim mi(pela) i go lukim tupela gen
insait long amamas bilong glori bilong yu long heven.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
Lord, mipela i ofarim dispela sakrifais
bilong helpim papa na mama bilong mi(pela).
Mipela i askim yu,
givim amamas bilong oltaim long tupela long ples bilong yu.
Long dispela ples, olgeta manmeri i stap laip.
Na wanpela de, bungim mi(pela) wantaim tupela gen
long amamas bilong oltaim wantaim ol Santu.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
Lord, dispela Sakramen bilong heven,
nau tasol mipela i bin kisim,
i ken helpim papa na mama bilong mi(pela)
long kisim malolo na lait bilong oltaim.
Mipela i pre, bai wanpela de,
mi(pela i) ken bungim tupela gen long glori bilong yu long heven.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.

items.title: Bilong helpim ol famili, ol pren, na ol manmeri i bin mekim gut long mipela
items.collect:
God, yu save pogivim mipela,
na yu bin kisim bek mipela.
Mipela i pre bilong helpim ol famili,
ol pren na ol manmeri i bin mekim gut long mipela,
na ol i lusim pinis dispela graun.
Mipela i askim yu, bai pre bilong Santu Maria, em i Virgo oltaim,
na pre bilong ol Santu,
i ken helpim ol long kamap long amamas bilong oltaim.
Mipela i askim dispela samting long nem bilong Jisas Krais,
em i Bikpela bilong mipela, Pikinini bilong yu.
Em i stap laip na em i King wantaim yu na wantaim Holi Spirit,
God bilong oltaim.
items.offerings:
God, marimari bilong yu i no gat arere bilong em.
Nau mipela i pre bilong helpim sol bilong ol famili,
ol pren na ol manmeri i bin mekim gut long mipela.
Na mipela i laik ofarim dispela Sakramen
i save kisim bek mipela long yu.
Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong dispela Sakramen
i ken tekewe ol sin bilong ol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
items.postcommunion:
God, yu strong olgeta, na yu pulap long marimari.
Mipela i bin ofarim dispela sakrifais
bilong litimapim nem bilong yu, na bilong helpim ol famili,
ol pren na ol manmeri i bin mekim gut long mipela.
Mipela i pre, bai strong bilong dispela Sakramen
i ken tekewe ol sin bilong ol, na yu ken marimari long ol,
na givim lait na amamas bilong oltaim long ol.
Mipela i pre long nem bilong Krais, em i Bikpela bilong mipela.
